itemListElement.name: Read AI vs Otter AI in 2026: Which Should US Teams Pick?

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI or Otter AI better for meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: For live transcription and lower cost, Otter is better. For engagement analytics, coaching and shareable reports, choose Read AI. The real question is whether you need a record of what was said, or feedback on how the meeting went and how to improve it. Test both on real calls.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Otter AI and Read AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: The split is simple. Otter AI focuses on live, searchable transcripts, while Read AI focuses on meeting reports with engagement, talk-time and coaching insights. Each summarizes meetings and lists action items. People who reread what was said tend to prefer Otter; managers who want feedback on how meetings went lean to Read AI.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI cheaper than Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Read AI Pro costs $15 a month billed yearly versus $8.33 for Otter Pro. On monthly billing, Read AI Pro is $19.75 and Otter Pro is $16.99. For a 10-person team on annual billing, that is about $1,800 a year for Read AI Pro versus $1,000 for Otter Pro.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI show a live transcript like Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, partly: it offers live notes during meetings, including on its free plan (5 sessions a month). Otter goes further, since the live transcript is its core feature on every plan. Free limits differ as well. Read AI's free plan caps each meeting at 1 hour, while Otter's free plan cuts each conversation at 30 minutes.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for Microsoft Teams, Read AI or Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, each tool joins Microsoft Teams meetings, and Read AI also offers a Microsoft Teams marketplace app. If your company prefers built-in tools, Teams' AI recap requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Whichever you pick, it appears as a visible participant, so tell attendees at the start of the call.

mainEntity.name: Do Read AI and Otter support languages other than English?

acceptedAnswer.text: Some do. Read AI lists support for 20+ languages, whereas Otter focuses mainly on English. Lynkk supports 17 languages plus auto-detect, including Hindi and a Hinglish setting for mixed Hindi and English.
